semantic_fixtures.covers: Actual BeginSpellCast reserves Crawler on stack before publication; its live CDA uses the pending caster's unequal hand size rather than the physical owner.
Existing battlefield projection publishes authoritative live 3/3 without an activated ability; an invented activation is rejected without state mutation.
The live all-zone CDA counts the owner outside battlefield, itself in hand, and current battlefield controller; layer 7b setter and layer 7c modifier/counter apply after the CDA.

Actual cast counts the reduced hand on stack/entry; an actual token copy retains the CDA and uses its own controller rather than freezing source size; face-down values and ability removal suppress the CDA.
A spell controlled by another player uses that player's unequal hand size, independently of physical owner/base controller.
Two successful draws create two distinct triggers; controller life is unchanged, opponent loses two life; opponent draw does not trigger.
A zero-hand unmodified Crawler is 0/0 and moves to its owner's graveyard at the next SBA check.
Casting the last draw spell causes Crawler to die before resolution; those later successful draws do not create triggers from the absent source.
No SBA interrupts Tolarian Winds during the temporary empty hand; Crawler survives the completed discard/draw and generates one trigger per drawn card.
Empty-library attempts produce no draw event or Crawler trigger.
Captured triggers retain their controller after source departure/new generation; all three opponents each lose two life, and the controller is unchanged.
